acceptance: Rerun green twice in a row on clickhouse-server (notuning, then tuned and notuning matrix as applicable)
Regression test covering rerun-into-existing-tables for both tuned and notuning modes
context: Reproduced 2026-10-07 against mocker-hosted ClickHouse 25.8 with CLICKHOUSE_MEMORY_LIMIT=5.25g. Full failing log: /tmp/ch-notuning-ctrl.log. Tuned rerun reference showing "Dropped database": /tmp/ch-benefit-sf1-tuned-rerun.log (ssb-tuned cell). Related code: run-connection/database lifecycle in benchbox/platforms/base + clickhouse setup.py create_connection/handle_existing_database.
description:
Rerun-hygiene inconsistency between tuning modes on clickhouse-server.

Repro steps:
1. BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR=~/Developer/benchmark_runs benchbox run --platform clickhouse-server --benchmark tpch --scale 1 --seed 42 --tuning notuning --phases generate,load ...
2. Run the exact same command a second time against the same server/database.
3. Second run fails during schema creation with Code: 57. DB::Exception: Table default.region already exists (exits 1), because it issues plain CREATE TABLE without IF NOT EXISTS and without dropping first.

Contrast: a --tuning tuned run drops the pre-existing database/tables before recreating them (log shows "Dropped database").

Expected behavior: notuning reruns are idempotent like tuned runs (recreate or reuse cleanly), or fail early with an actionable message before partial work.

Constraint: any drop-behavior change is destructive and needs owner review before implementation.
